title: Lines invoiced before the release keep their invoiced category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use staging, where invoices from before the release are kept.
  • Have a part line on staging invoiced before the release in a customer-named category (for example a category named after a fleet customer).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick the month of that invoice in the Date filter.
  3. Open the customer-named category's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • The customer-named category has a row in that month.
  • Its Parts Invoiced includes that part line's sales.

Step 3:

  • The category opens to a Before tiers row.
